A missing terminal liquidation is not universally an error for an open factor-return series.

Training indices precede OOS indices; the actual custom-calendar sample still requires original dates.

vUseThisObs(idx) = mDataTemp(find(~isnan(mDataTemp(:,idx)),1,'last'), idx);
Thus it searches the full year. b02 uses the helper for technical indicators246, close305, market cap323. Synthetic week1=[10,10,10,10,10,10,NaN], week2=100s -> original week1=100. Changing only future week2 to200 -> earlier output200. A week-local fallback gives10 in both. One isolated one-line patch replacing both mDataTemp references in that expression with mDataDailyTemp is prepared; git apply --check and exact applied bytes verified. No claim that MATLAB runtime or complete system is validated.
2) Future outcome availability changes inference: b02 line73 truncates DAILY CROSS-SECTION returns; line77 removes changed close observations; line286 requires all daily returns for weekly target. b05 line115 masks lagged features using nonmissing CURRENT TARGET-WEEK return, then ranks at131. fCreatePanelFast68 removes missing targets. fSingleSortMulti114/124 again drops sorting values when target mRet missing BEFORE quantiles133 and weight normalization190. With fixed prior scores1..30 and equal known market caps, missing only target30 changes H from25..30 to24..29 (both cross-sections meet25 minimum and quintiles meet5 assets). This is target-availability bias, not direct use of future numeric test Y in fitted coefficients. Top-level fCreateIndices43/44 and fWalkforwardCSENET176..204 correctly fit prior windows; vYout is only used to size fallback arrays.
3) Costs: fSingleSortMulti316 prepends zero previous target weights (initial entry included);320 charges sum(abs(target_prev-target_now)),353 multiplies by long tc,375 subtracts from gross return. This ignores holdings drift. Previous weights50/50, previous returns100%/0%, same target50/50 => proxy zero but required pre-cost gross rebalance1/3 NAV. If current target equals drifted2/3,1/3, proxy positive although no rebalance is required; error can under OR overcharge. GKX turnover403 has separate drift expression using SAME target-period mRet column; it does not feed charged costs. Terminal liquidation is not appended; do not call that a defect for an open factor-return series, only for a required terminal-flat wallet report.
4) Drawdown: fMaxDD24 computes cumsum(returns);27 -diff;30 maxk. fSingleSortMulti294/295 similarly uses adjacent changes. For synthetic returns+10%,-10%,-10%, output10% vs true compounded peak-to-trough drawdown19%. This is a metric defect, not a measured finding that the model loses.
5) Data/runtime provenance: b02 line19 lUseArtData=true by DEFAULT;25 loads generated artificial data; real branch29 loads a different .mat. Both save same output filenames334/339; b05 has no provenance assertion. README explicitly says artificial data only for technical check. Six raw CoinMarketCap CSVs and MetaData.mat are absent from ZIP, as are external analysis dependencies. No real financial reproduction has occurred. fallback سالانه: جایگزینی 
mDataTemp
 با 
mDataDailyTemp
 در همان عبارت، خطای نگاه به آینده را در سطح محاسبه‌ی شاخص اصلاح می‌کند؛ این یک نقص واقعی در کد اصلی است (نه فقط unknown)، چون با داده مصنوعی بازتولید شده.

mRet
 غیرموجود ← حذف cross-section ← تغییر quintile، مستقیماً نتیجه می‌شود. این «استفاده مستقیم از Y آینده در ضرایب» نیست، اما سوگیری انتخاب است.
هزینه بدون drift: از خطوط ۳۱۶–۳۷۵ نتیجه می‌شود که proxy می‌تواند کم یا زیاد هزینه بزند؛ این یک نقص حسابداری است.

artificial data پیش‌فرض: provenance تأیید نمی‌شود؛ بازتولید مالی واقعی رخ نداده.

 «باگ» برای terminal-liquidation در factor-return باز، درست نیست. «جدید بودن جهانی» ادعا نشود. «عدم امکان OHLCV» نتیجه نمی‌شود. بازده مقاله تأییدیه‌ی ما نیست.
آیا Demo مستقیم مسدود بماند؟
 بله. تا (۱) patch fallback اعمال و پین شود، (۲) سیاست target-availability صریح شود (مثلاً cross-section ثابت قبل از حذف)، (۳) هزینه با drift بازنویسی شود، (۴) DD مرکب جایگزین شود، (۵) provenance از real data تأیید شود، و (۶) حداقل سفارش venue با ۵۰۰ wallet جدا بررسی شود — هیچ Demo admission مجاز نیست. اینها defects/unknowns مشخص‌اند، نه دلیل بر شکست اقتصادی.

 اعمال patch یک‌خطی fallback + تست رگرسیون مصنوعی همان سناریوی week1/week2؛ سپس یک بازبینی کد مستقل روی هزینه‌ی drift و target-availability با fixture مصنوعی، بدون خواندن قیمت. H به‌عنوان پای long منتشرشده حفظ می‌شود. هیچ بکتست بازار یا ادعای سودآوری مجاز نیست.

coordinator_review.text: The user upload resolved the CTREND source-content blocker. Archive SHA256 76671b6e018e1862ebfe1142ed6942ab40b9b9653f90087f50803e810ebb41ec; 67 extracted code/readme files verified unchanged. Two internal Codex source reviews plus coordinator source-bound synthetic diagnostics confirmed year-wide missing-endpoint fallback, target-return-availability contamination before rank/portfolio formation, target-weight cost proxy that can undercharge or overcharge rebalancing, and an adjacent-period-loss metric mislabeled maximum drawdown. DeepSeek round c834b1f6d0fb4a1b8e6d820b0da0f976, answer 23, SHA256 fde2d0431870bb6f72b38ca93d33bd8164fd17db00bed76ab512efcb3667bc4b, reviewed supplied snippets and witnesses and agreed direct Demo remains blocked. A one-line isolated resampler patch is prepared, git-apply checked and byte-verified; originals are untouched. Eleven source-equivalent Python synthetic diagnostics already cover the proposed minimal regression/cost/selection checks, so do not repeat them without a new change. Vendor MATLAB was not executed; original raw CMC data is absent, default preprocessing is artificial, published result XLSX was not read, and no financial backtest or profit claim occurred. Proper prior-window fitting is present; do not falsely claim direct future test-Y fitting. A full causal derivative requires separate inference rows independent of future targets, ex-ante universe/weights, explicit missing-held-outcome accounting without renormalizing future survivors, drift/cash/fee accounting and true NAV drawdown, then real-input provenance and Bybit order feasibility for the 500 USDT wallet. Preserving a pre-outcome set alone does not fix later future-survivor renormalization. H remains a published long leg; physical stops and final liquidation are not universal factor definitions. This is an implementation-correctness block, not economic rejection, global novelty, an OHLCV ban, permission to retune closed negative protocols, or admission to Demo. The frozen BTC/ETH future study is untouched.
